# Leverly

Leverly is a platform that integrates with various applications to automate workflows and processes.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/leverly/.

## Actions

- **List Reattempts**: List all reattempts in leverly.
- **Stop Leverly Reattempts**: Stop ongoing reattempts for a lead in leverly.
